test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The city turned out / to be very / different to what / he had expected.
solution:
The correct answer is 'different to what'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part is different to what.
 
• In the given sentence, a comparison is being made between what the subject (he) thought about the city and the reality.
 
• When comparisons are made, the **preposition to **cannot be used. 
 
• In order to introduce the second element of comparison, we need to use '**from'. **
 
• Thus, the error lies in using **to **instead of **'from' **for comparison.
 
• So, the error lies in **option 1 i.e., different to what**
 
• The sentence can be corrected by using **different than what**

*Correct sentence - **The city turned out / to be very / **different from what **/ he had expected.*
